QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_14

question.text: Operating expenses (statutory, legal, tax, audit, communication, etc.) in a typical AIF are capped at what range, as indicated in Ch 9?

answer.text: 1 to 5 basis points of NAV or commitments per annum
100 to 500 basis points of NAV or commitments per annum
10 to 50 basis points of NAV or capital commitments per annum, whichever is higher
Uncapped — all expenses are on actuals

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that operating expenses are typically capped at 10-50 bps on NAV or capital commitments, whichever is higher, and include statutory, legal, tax, audit, communication and similar expenses. The Trap: Option A is unrealistically tight. Option B (100-500 bps) is too high and overlaps with the management fee. Option D confuses operating expenses with transaction expenses, which are on actuals without limit. Note: Anchor to the 10-50 bps cap and the workbook's list of qualifying expense categories.
